chapter: Floods, Mardi Gras and street music
title: Mardi Gras song, masking and Indians; what George played
summary: George played everything he heard; she sings a Mardi Gras song and describes plain costumes, masking as Indians, and Tati's gang.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: What kind of pieces did George play when he was a boy?
Everything he heard. Everything he heard. He practiced and tried and make a mistake and come back until he played right.

If you don't see it, you'll be a baby Your heart will become like a pig Fom, Fom, quitte mo ba le cal a adieu Fom, abadadou bara c'est moi Fom, Fom, quitte mo ba le cal a adieu Fom, abadadou bara c'est moi That's Mardi Gros song They walk and sing and it was more the girl then, it was worth looking at Now they growing pretty now No
The costumes or the parades, what was better? Were the parades better or did everybody mask?

pretty costumes? No they didn't have no pretty costumes in the Mardi Gras my days. They masked, some would mask and plenty Indians but they dressed like the Indian. They didn't no fancy thing. They had guinea blue dress with the yellow bias you know and red and their little short waist like that you know like the real Indian were. Yes. And they danced and they had the basket on the like real Indian. Now the Indian is not real Indian and they fall down the room and sit down and cross the leg like this and eat out of the gammel. It was pretty. Some would mask in Spanish, Spaniard you know. Try to imitate dress like all different kind of nation. And after a while then they begin to dance like ballet then it wasn't at all the same. As they're dancing out in the streets. Yeah sure in the streets. My cousin Tati which would be 89 years old now in March, he used to have a gang, his band you know. And when they'd hear him coming when they'd hear that song of Fum Fum Kite Mubalakalla everybody would run all their Tati's band and they'd have an old piece of room and they'd sweep and they'd dance and they'd sweep and they'd dance. It was really amusing.
